behavior_changed: Unexplained-residual pairing uses max($100, 2% of the bank amount) instead of a $50/$12.40 demo window.
One bank item with multiple same-amount ledgers is not auto EXACT_MATCHed unless those ledgers share a reference.
A provider payout marked AWAITING_BANK becomes MATCH once the statement deposit equals the provider net (fees/refunds already in that net).
Fee evidence referenced by bank transaction ID is accepted, not only description-text overlap.
Reviewer rejects a MATCHED preparer conclusion when an unexplained residual remains.
Post-close classification uses calendar period-end, not only the later lock timestamp.
Missing-support is a registered control (AUD-SUP-001), not only a sampling risk signal.
Audit independently re-tests PO authorized amount vs approval limit (AUD-THR-001).
Final eval compares close journal account/amount/period/source fields instead of awarding credit for task completion alone.
Audit extras are classified as CONFIRMED_CONTROL_FAILURE vs RISK_INDICATOR using existing result/severity fields.
Cash arithmetic, disposition, and provider-awareness are scored separately so EXACT_MATCH vs PROVIDER_PAYOUT naming is not the only grade.
